mandates.title: AI agent payment mandates
mandates.intro: Give an AI agent limited permission (a mandate) to pay for bookings on your behalf. Each mandate is capped by amount and time and can be limited to specific listings; you can revoke it at any time.
mandates.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
mandates.propertiesHint: To allow only specific listings, enter their IDs separated by commas.
mandates.tokenOnce: This signed mandate is shown only once. Give it to your agent; do not share it with anyone else.
mandates.scoped: {count, plural, one {Limited to # listing} other {Limited to # listings}}
mandates.revoked: Mandate revoked; the agent can no longer pay with it.
mandates.createFailed: Could not create the permission. Please try again.
mandates.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the permission. Please try again.
mandates.revokeConfirmBody: The permission with a {amount} limit, valid until {date}, will be revoked. Your agent will no longer be able to pay with it and this cannot be undone; you would need to grant a new permission.
